label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar (modified from user-provided Referer header) used in response.getWriter().format(), which could inject malicious content if bar contains format specifiers. Alert 2 (java/tainted-format-string): alert-TP — resolved sink value is bar (user-provided Referer header) directly used as the format string in response.getWriter().format(), allowing format string exploitation. Case TP: at least one alert-TP.

evidence.note: User-provided Referer header is decoded and assigned to param, then modified into bar. Bar is used as format string in response.getWriter().format(), creating a format string vulnerability.
Bar is used as the format string argument in response.getWriter().format(), directly exposing user input to format string injection.
